item.title: Q & A: Halacha & the Oral Law (Part II)
item.description: Question: The Written Law is there plain to see as it’s found in the five Books of Moses. However, from whence does the Oral Law come? I’m not asking as one who doubts its veracity – rather, I would simply like to know and not just follow blindly. Mark Grosz Via E-mail The post Q & A: Halacha & the Oral Law (Part II) appeared first on The Jewish Press - JewishPress.com.

item.title: Persuaded – Chapter XXXVIII
item.description: He was a total fair-weather friend! When my husband began to have business problems, Yerucham didn’t come forward to help. I tried to ask him for help—I did it behind my husband’s back, because I didn’t want Benjy to be embarrassed—but he never responded. item.title: Why We Celebrate Tree Planting
item.description: Chazal teach us that tree planting is the best way to emulate and draw close to G-d (V”R 25:3). Hashem planted trees when He created the world, and we are commanded to do so upon entering Eretz Yisrael.
